hypothesis: DecisionPoint Price Momentum Oscillator (PMO, Carl Swenlin): double-smoothed 1-period ROC oscillator (35-period custom smooth of daily pct-change *10, then 20-period custom smooth = PMO Line; 10-period EMA of PMO Line = Signal Line). PMO crossing above its Signal Line, gated by close > SMA(trend_window), signals a long entry (MACD-signal-line-crossover analog per StockCharts ChartSchool's own comparison); exit on cross-down, trend filter break, or max_hold_days time-stop. First PMO strategy in this repo -- distinct from MACD (plain EMA diff) and PPO (id=2026-09-04-109, EMA-ratio construction).
